title: tensor-only dynamic-shape specialization
authoring_note: This anchor has no graph break. The baseline compiles a pure tensor graph with dynamic=False, so the variable-shape schedule triggers specialization; the oracle marks the varying batch dimension before torch.compile and keeps the same model, optimizer, and schedule. The primary metric includes the full schedule and keeps steady-state latency as a secondary diagnostic. The calibration range is frozen from three independent same-host oracle runs; the unrounded CI envelope is recorded in oracle/calibration.json.
